Demand estimated as waiting-list tests + year-on-year ΔWL/12; April activity is bank-holiday depressed. growth from earliest pair (April 2024 vs April 2025). Growth applied at whole-diagnostics level (modality recoding caution as per RTT).

standard.note: milestones are a modelling assumption aligned to the RTT trajectory: 95% under 6 weeks by Apr-27, 99% (constitutional <1% over) by Apr-29
